**Tool: Write**

Request:
```json
{
  "file_path": "baseline.md",
  "content": "# Baseline: Recommendation Service v2.3.0

## Version identity
- **Release:** v2.3.0
- **Source:** PR #482 (merged to production ~1 hour ago as of 2026-07-03)
- **Commit SHA:** TBD - fill in exact merge commit hash so this baseline can be rebuilt precisely, not just approximated via PR number
- **Deployed to:** production

## Decision this baseline came from
QA sign-off on the new eval suite (precision and recall both improved vs. prior baseline), followed by production deploy. No separate ship.md decision record exists yet for this release - this document is currently the only record of the accept decision. Recommend creating one if this workflow is used for future releases.

## What's included (controlled scope)
- **Embedding model dependency:** upgraded embed-v1 to embed-v2
- **Eval suite:** the new/updated eval suite used for QA sign-off (precision, recall both improved over prior baseline)
- Everything else in the recommendation service is assumed unchanged by this release - **not confirmed**, since no change-impact.md exists documenting what else PR #482 touched.

## What's explicitly excluded / not covered
- No linked eval report, dataset, or metrics artifact - only the verbal claim "precision and recall both improved" is recorded here.
- No downstream consumer or ripple-effect review is on file (e.g., serving latency, feature store compatibility, any client assumptions baked around embed-v1 output shape/dimensionality).
- No rollback procedure/tested rollback path is documented for reverting embed-v2 to embed-v1 in production.

## Evidence links
- Eval suite results: missing - add link/path
- QA sign-off record: missing - add link/path (ticket, Slack thread, doc)
- PR: #482 (add URL)
- Commit SHA: missing - add

## Accepted gaps (owner needed for each)
| Gap | Risk if unaddressed | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| No linked eval report/metrics artifact | Can't independently re-verify the "improved precision/recall" claim later | unassigned |
| No documented rollback path for embed-v2 to embed-v1 | Slower/riskier recovery if this version needs to be reverted | unassigned |
| No change-impact review of what else PR #482 touched | Unknown blast radius if problems surface later | unassigned |
| Only ~1 hour of production observation at time of recording | Stability claim is provisional, not confirmed | unassigned |

## Re-check / new-baseline triggers
- Any further change to the embedding model dependency (version bump, provider change, or config change to embed-v2).
- Production incident, precision/recall regression, or user-facing quality complaint traced to recommendations.
- Completion of a longer soak period (recommend: re-confirm stability at 24h and 7 days post-deploy; update this record or supersede it).
- Any change to eval suite methodology or dataset used for future sign-offs (so future comparisons stay apples-to-apples with this baseline).
- Discovery of undocumented scope from PR #482 (i.e., if change-impact.md is written later and reveals additional changes not listed above).

## Status
**Provisional.** This baseline documents the accept decision as understood at recording time, but is missing evidence links and has only ~1 hour of production observation. Treat as accepted-with-open-gaps until the gaps above are closed or explicitly owned/deferred.
"
}
```
